Title: Kathy Velikov Elevated to the AIA College of Fellows
AwardingBody: American Institute of Architects, College of Fellows
Summary: Kathy Velikov elevated to Fellow of the American Institute of Architects (FAIA).
BodyHTML:
In February 2025 Kathy Velikov was elevated to the American Institute of Architects College of Fellows. Fewer than 3% of architects hold the fellowship.

She was nominated through the AIA Michigan chapter and recognized for "furthering the science and art of planning and building by advancing the standards of architectural education and training", the AIA Object for contributions in education, research and literature. The new Fellows were honored at AIA25 in Boston, 4–6 June 2025.

"I am truly honored to be recognized for my work by the AIA and the distinguished jury of peers." (Kathy Velikov)

Image.alt: Kathy Velikov Elevated to the AIA College of Fellows (2025), text card

Title: ACADIA Society Award for Leadership
AwardingBody: Association for Computer Aided Design in Architecture (ACADIA)
Summary: Kathy Velikov received the ACADIA Society Award for Leadership for extraordinary contributions and service to the ACADIA community.
BodyHTML:
The ACADIA Board gave Kathy Velikov the 2023 Society Award for Leadership for "extraordinary contributions and service to the ACADIA community". She served as President of ACADIA from 2018 to 2020 and as Vice President from 2021 to 2022.

As President she created the ACADIA Diversity Committee and updated the organization's publication ethics; during her tenure the Board became substantially more diverse. The jury cited "the significant role that Kathy Velikov has played in ACADIA's leadership".

Her award talk, "Cultivating a Community of Practice", was given on 26 October 2023.
